name: Unusually Large Transfer
description: Compares transaction amount against customer established distribution (percentiles and typical amounts).

name: New Payee Burst
description: Identifies rapid multiple transactions sent to a newly added payee within a short time window.

name: Odd-Hours Activity
description: Flags activity during odd hours (00:00 - 05:00) when customer history shows little to no historical activity.

name: Behavioural Pattern Break
description: Flags significant structural shifts in channel distribution, transaction velocity, or frequency in recent activity.
